# get_distances_for_path { #mofography.compute.get_distances_for_path }

```python
compute.get_distances_for_path(
    path_indices,
    shape,
    ase_atoms,
    n_neighbors=10,
    radii=None,
)
```

Minimum framework surface distance at each path voxel (neighbor query minus covalent radii).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                      | Default    |
|--------------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| path_indices |        | the indices of the path                                                                                                                          | _required_ |
| shape        |        | the shape of the grid                                                                                                                            | _required_ |
| ase_atoms    |        | the ase atoms object for the framework                                                                                                           | _required_ |
| n_neighbors  |        | the number of neighbors to consider for each grid point, defaults to 10 (optional)                                                               | `10`       |
| radii        |        | the covalent radii of the atoms in the structure. If not provided, they will be calculated from the atomic numbers using ase.data.covalent_radii | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                          |
|--------|--------|------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | The distances between the atoms and the grid points. |
